title: EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Screening input

queries.title: Names / entities / IDs to screen
queries.description: Names of persons, companies/entities, EU reference numbers (e.g. EU.27.28), or identification/registration numbers to screen against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List.

subjectType.title: Subject type filter
subjectType.description: Filter sanctions entries by subject classification: all, person, or enterprise.

programmes.title: Sanctions programmes (optional)
programmes.description: Optional filter by EU sanctions programme codes (e.g. RUS, UKR, BLR, IRN, SYR, IRQ).

country.title: Country ISO-2 filter (optional)
country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. RU, BY, IR, IQ) to restrict candidate entities by citizenship, address, birth or ID country.

fuzzyThreshold.title: Fuzzy similarity threshold (0.50 - 1.00)
fuzzyThreshold.description: Minimum similarity score [0.50..1.00] to report a non-exact candidate as a 'possible match'. Default: 0.78. Set to 1.0 for exact matches only.

maxMatchesPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxMatchesPerQuery.description: Maximum number of candidate sanctions entries returned per screened query.

includeClearQueries.title: Include clear (no-match) rows in dataset
includeClearQueries.description: When enabled, queries with zero matches still emit a 'clear' audit row in the output dataset.
